method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 从左轮枪从桌面抓起塞进她最爱毛衣的深口袋里。
facts.anchor: snatching the revolver from the tabletop and stuffing it into one of the deep pockets of her favorite sweater

facts.fact: Hattie 打开语音备忘录按了录音，然后用洗碗布盖住手机。
facts.anchor: She opens the voice memo app and presses record, then drapes a dish towel over it.

facts.fact: Dustin 的靴子踩过积雪的台阶和门廊，短暂停顿后敲了三下。
facts.anchor: There’s a short pause, then three quick knocks.

facts.fact: Dustin 说路糟透了，花了将近四个小时才到。
Dustin 发现正在录音的手机，把屏幕转向她并停掉了录音。
facts.anchor: He turns it toward her, revealing the active voice memo. He stops the recording.

facts.fact: Dustin 承认他撒了谎——他说没看见 Tommy 进 Cheryl 家，只是把他放下车，并说再撒一千次也愿意。
facts.anchor: I didn’t see Tommy go into Cheryl’s place, okay? I dropped him off, but I never saw him go in. I lied.

facts.fact: Tommy 从客厅的黑暗中冲出，全速撞向 Dustin。
facts.anchor: Tommy crashes into him at full speed.

facts.fact: Tommy 把 Dustin 的头往地板上猛撞，Colm 上前拉他却被甩开，后脑撞上冰箱、眼睛翻白。
facts.anchor: the back of his head connecting with the fridge. His eyes roll to white.

facts.fact: Colm 一把从 Hattie 手里夺过左轮，朝 Dustin 的前额开枪。
facts.anchor: he strips the revolver from her hand and shoots Dustin in the forehead.
